engine: one serial engine; II=actual scheduled service duration; unconditional per-core-cycle service

resource_environment.DYNAMIC602_MACS: dense MAC/cycle, 0 means modeled zero cost
resource_environment.DYNAMIC602_BANDWIDTH_BYTES_PER_CYCLE: resident weight and scratch bandwidth, default4*MACS

history_environment.DYNAMIC602_HISTORY_INSTRUCTIONS: NN observes only final chosen instruction interval of common noPF cache warmup;0empty h/c at ROI

boundary: Discard NN active inference and input/output work at ROI; retain only completed selected-history NN h/c; reset measurement counters. Conventional Stride, shadow teacher and nativeSPP retain the same full common warmup history in every history arm.

controls.DYNAMIC602_SILENT_SUPPRESS: suppress only outputs from events whose teacher was silent at arrival; forward compute/admission/h-c unchanged
controls.DYNAMIC602_REQUESTS_PER_MILLION_INSTRUCT: global strict cumulative request credits at prefetch_line for every L2 policy;0unlimited;chosen only on validation
controls.DYNAMIC602_KEEP_PPM: optional deterministic request thinning after full compute, default1000000

teacher: Measurement-only original Stride sees every eligible LOAD during common warmup and ROI. Retain common teacher state at ROI. Save each event action snapshot before NN admission including inputs later dropped; never query teacher at completion.

measurements.distributions: all-event log2 upper-bound histograms for queue-wait,service,completion-age,prior completed history,state-eviction histories
measurements.per_pc: all ROI completions/evictions plus resident lifetime update totals
measurements.dram: accepted actual RQ/WQ enqueues/merges, write-forwarding, actual bus starts, timestamped bus completions and real completed bytes, initial/end queue occupancy and initial busy channels
measurements.weights: one resident FP32 copy; analytical dense weight reads separate; modeled weight DRAM bytes0
measurements.requests: gate generation/budget suppression/page suppression; cache new-enqueue/merge/rejection; cohort first-demand timely/late by LOAD/RFO, eviction-unused, pending and resident-unused

limitations: same_page control assumes4KiB pages and64-byte lines, matching fixed ChampSim machine
warmup inherited controller uses dummy zero-cost DRAM; NN history is controlled separately but not a model of realistic warmup memory latency
legacy selected-accuracy metric remains useful/(issued-PQmerged); report actual cache outcome metrics separately
queue throughput formula is an architectural assumption, not synthesized hardware
category labels are descriptive; silent-output ablation supplies causal IPC comparison
